pages.title: From Your Computer
pages.text: Open Import and choose the computer upload action. Select a PNG, JPG, or JPEG file. The image is stored on the server. Server settings can disable uploads or limit file size and storage.

pages.title: From a URL
pages.text: Use Import to enter an image URL and load it. Private and local network addresses are blocked. Use a direct public image link. The server can disable URL downloads or limit their size.

pages.title: Import Permissions
pages.text: You need control access to change this display. Importing does not give other players access to your private image library. A public display can still let permitted viewers see its selected image.
